cadence.book_fixed_at: the stamp session, one or more sessions BEFORE the month end; recorded per manifest as stamp_date
cadence.traded_at: the following month's execution basis for the row, as listed above; the traded row is market-on-close
cadence.traded_how: whole-share legs as market-on-close orders; legs that size to fewer than two whole shares as dollar-based market orders in the final minutes of the session (about 23% of NAV in month one at $50k, falling as the account grows)

disclosure.anchor: K_0 is published in commit_anchor.json, so any released key authenticates itself by hashing forward to it.
disclosure.monotonic: Keys form a reverse hash chain: releasing month m's key discloses month m and every earlier month, and cannot disclose a later one. Cherry-picking which months to reveal is not possible -- that follows from SHA-256, not from our conduct.
disclosure.rule: The key for month m is released when month m+19 is committed.
disclosure.sealed: Every committed book is sealed (AES-256-GCM) and its ciphertext is published with the manifest, so the book is fixed and handed over before its outcome is known.

document: Quiet Ascent V1 -- public terms of the record
not_in_this_file: Universe definition, feature set, training window, model parameters, ladder depth and position count are deliberately absent. Nothing here reveals more than a published manifest already does.
purpose: What can be verified WITHOUT any disclosure of the calculation rules. The claim supported here is about selection, not about the strategy.

roster.fixed: The roster is fixed. Every month commits all of these rows. A change to the set is a roster change and is logged in manifest.roster_changes with a date and reason; an empty roster_changes across the chain means the set has never moved.

what_a_reader_can_check_today: The manifest chain is unbroken: each month's prev_manifest_sha256 is the previous month's chain value, and chain = sha256(prev || body_sha).
Each manifest is Bitcoin-timestamped (OpenTimestamps), so its content existed at the stamped time and cannot have been written later.
Exactly one roster row is marked run in each manifest, and it is the row named as traded above -- declared in the same signed document as the eleven it is not.
roster_changes is empty across the chain, so the set of books has never been reshaped around a result.
The pre-registration file is committed by sha256 AND byte count, so it is append-only: truncate the current file to the recorded length and it must hash to the recorded value.
The specification is committed by hash, so the rules could not change between months without the change being visible.
what_requires_disclosure: The books themselves -- names and weights -- which are sealed until their key is released under the rule above.
The calculation rules, which are disclosable under NDA and are not in this file.
